parties.respondent: M/s. Lexus Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and others

summary: Share transfer validity vs forgery claims; consideration paid but disputed purpose; blank document fabrication defense rejected; shareholder status determination; oppression/mismanagement allegations; limitation arguments; interim relief status quo order reviewed; share certificate authenticity challenge; financial transaction tracing necessity; NCLT jurisdiction over fraud claims affirmed.
final_judgment: Case remanded for further inquiry into genuineness of share transfer and oppression allegations.
